import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp_tests')
import ref
from harness import ok

def both(doc, label):
    a = ok(doc)
    zones = [ref.Zone(z['origin'], [(r['owner'], r['type'], ref.canon_data(r['type'], r['data'])) for r in z['records']]) for z in doc['zones']]
    print('==', label)
    for run in a['runs']:
        q = next(x for x in doc['queries'] if x['id']==run['query'])
        p = next(x for x in doc['profiles'] if x['id']==run['profile'])
        rc, term, fin, ans, tr = ref.resolve(q['name'], q['type'], p, zones)
        assert rc==run['rcode'] and term==run['termination'] and fin==run['final_name'] and ans==run['answer'] and tr==run['trace'], (run, (rc,term,fin,ans,tr))
        print(' ', run['query'], run['profile'], run['rcode'], run['termination'], run['final_name'], [(x['owner'],x['type'],x['data']) for x in run['answer']], run['trace'])
    print('  diag', a['diagnostic'])

# Case A: shadowing by a more specific empty zone
both({"zones":[{"origin":"test.","records":[{"owner":"x.sub.test.","type":"A","data":"192.0.2.1"},{"owner":"*.test.","type":"A","data":"192.0.2.99"}]},
               {"origin":"sub.test.","records":[]}],
      "profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":2,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}],
      "queries":[{"id":"q1","name":"x.sub.test.","type":"A","cost":1},{"id":"q2","name":"sub.test.","type":"A","cost":1},{"id":"q3","name":"w.sub.test.","type":"A","cost":1},{"id":"q4","name":"w.test.","type":"A","cost":1}],
      "observations":[]}, 'shadowing')

# Case B: cname into a more specific zone with wildcard there
both({"zones":[{"origin":"test.","records":[{"owner":"c.test.","type":"CNAME","data":"w.sub.test."}]},
               {"origin":"sub.test.","records":[{"owner":"*.sub.test.","type":"A","data":"198.51.100.5"}]}],
      "profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":2,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"},{"id":"o","max_aliases":2,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"off"}],
      "queries":[{"id":"q","name":"c.test.","type":"A","cost":1}],
      "observations":[]}, 'cross-zone wildcard')

# Case C: repeated record retained; loop with duplicate answers
both({"zones":[{"origin":"test.","records":[{"owner":"a.test.","type":"CNAME","data":"b.test."},{"owner":"b.test.","type":"CNAME","data":"c.test."},{"owner":"c.test.","type":"CNAME","data":"a.test."}]}],
      "profiles":[{"id":"p3","max_aliases":3,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"},{"id":"p9","max_aliases":9,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}],
      "queries":[{"id":"q","name":"a.test.","type":"A","cost":1}],
      "observations":[]}, '3-cycle')

# Case D: wildcard at root zone + one-label
